text: We're obsessed with home energy dashboards to slash carbon footprints, but we're missing a massive blind spot: accessibility. Most of these interfaces rely heavily on complex color-coded graphs and dense data visualizations that are difficult for people with visual impairments or cognitive disabilities to navigate. If we want a truly inclusive energy transition, our tools must move beyond just flashy aesthetics. A dashboard that isn't accessible to everyone isn't just flawed—it leaves vulnerable users behind.
